# Change record

Use the project's existing format when available. Populate only observed or agreed information; retain `not recorded` for unknowns. Link authoritative documents instead of duplicating their requirements.

## Identity and requested activity

- Change ID and title: not recorded
- Kind: new development / evolution / defect investigation
- Primary request or issue: not recorded
- Code and issue repositories: not recorded
- Current requested activity and selected tasks: not recorded
- Current handoff status: not recorded
- Definition of done and source: not recorded

## Context and scope

- Current and desired behavior, actors and scope: not recorded
- Brief/specification source and user agreement source: not recorded
- Affected modules and profile/source references: not recorded
- Policies, standards, glossary and decision references: not recorded
- Constraints, impact, exclusions and open decisions/owners: not recorded

## Design and acceptance

- Contracts, alternatives and decision references: not recorded
- Compatibility/integration strategy: not recorded
- Agreed test interfaces and validation strategy: not recorded
- Acceptance criterion IDs and authoritative source: not recorded

## Tasks

| Task ID | Outcome and criteria | Dependencies | State | Issue/draft | Branch/PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Validation evidence

| Criterion/task | Module | Procedure/environment | Evaluated scope and state | Result | Evidence reference and limitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Review

- Reviewed comparison/state and specification/standards sources: not recorded
- Evaluated implementation/configuration/input scope and report destination: not recorded
- Specification conclusion/findings: not recorded
- Standards conclusion/findings: not recorded
- Required reviews/checks and actual evidence: not recorded
- Superseded evidence and affected work: not recorded

## Delivery

- Version, destination, owners and procedure source: not recorded
- Prepared package and prerequisites: not recorded
- Integration/merge state and evidence: not recorded
- Deployment/execution state and evidence: not recorded
- Operational verification and recovery status: not recorded
- Issue completion against definition of done: not recorded

## Diagnosis or retrospective

- Symptom/reproduction/experiments/cause or session observations: not recorded
- Correction or improvement proposals, owners and validation: not recorded

## Latest handoff

- Completed requested activity and result: not recorded
- Actual artifacts and evaluated state: not recorded
- Outstanding decisions/checks/access/approvals and owners: not recorded
- Suggested next activity and invocation: not recorded
- Sources to read when resuming: not recorded
